title: Zig 2026: No-AI Policy, $670K Foundation, Left GitHub & Why Zig Isn’t 1.0 - Andrew Kelley Explains
summary: JetBrains interviews Zig creator Andrew Kelley about why Zig has no 1.0 after a decade, why the project left GitHub, and why it bans AI contributions. He also covers what makes Zig better than C and his views on open source.
why: HN commenters point to it as a convincing primary-source interview showing Zig's cohesive design vision and the creator's level-headed reasoning.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: convinced me more than any design doc or blogpost could
